title: Yellowed Golden Irish Mozzarella Bake
description: A rich and comforting Irish dish featuring mozzarella cheese, perfect for a sick day, baked in a wood-fired oven and wrapped in a corn husk vessel, making it Buddhist-temple-friendly due to its vegetarian and dairy-based ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded mozzarella cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Divide the cheese mixture into 6 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Wrap each ball in a corn husk, securing it with a strip of corn husk if needed.
Place the wrapped cheese balls in the wood-fired oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Brush the tops with melted butter and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the cheese balls from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
